approvalText: I, Sagar (sagarbora91), reviewed the 17 capability deltas enumerated in verification/audit/ETP-CAPABILITY-DELTA-FOR-APPROVAL-2026-08-21.md, SHA-256 cf0b908575f8dc70dd8ccfc1b525756f9c0e22aeb39f2bfe55ce00b1763b4a0d, covering the capability inventory moving from 660 to 680 when Retail ETP became the twelfth modular module. I confirm the 14 new ETP capabilities are intended and belong in the shipped product, including etp:action:etpconfirm which publishes a financial generation; that the shell route swap is the intended relocation of ETP from a shell button to a Reports-owned route; and that the home-FAB binding is structural. Decision: APPROVE.
correctionToPackage: The package stated the home-FAB delta belongs in EXPECTED_STRUCTURAL_ACTION_IDS. That list covers 'changed' visible-actions; this delta is 'added', so it is classified by an added-rule instead. The classification is equivalent and the approval is unaffected.

authorizes: Classification of these exact 17 deltas in scripts/analyze-modular-capability-delta.mjs
Regeneration of MODULAR-CAPABILITY-DELTA-LEDGER with these deltas recorded as approved
Raising the analyser's expected capability inventory from 660 to 680
doesNotClose: MAH-3 visual baseline capture and fluent review
rendered-language matrix recapture and identity-bound visual approval
staff UAT, legal approval, production signing, release approval

registryNote: Approval evidence for Phase 5 item 5B-2, recorded separately from the analyser exactly as the 107-row capability approval was. Any delta not listed above remains unclassified and the gate stays fail-closed for it.
